provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: LinkInventory::build derives chapters from SUMMARY order and resolves exact chapter/fragment identity, retains source spans and distinguishes local containing targets. document extracts Markdown/reference links, roles and literal MathJax hrefs while excluding code/comments and rejecting unsupported HTML/URL forms. Tests cover all named syntaxes, external reference definitions, wrong-chapter global IDs and source-order differences. All SourceLinks, including future notes, require audit generation; cycles remain candidates rather than automatic exemptions.
limitations: This is a source-level comparison of the retained authored unit, exact cited declarations/tests and policy. It is not proof of exhaustive implementation behavior, a browser rendering test or a claim that every conservative context file was read. The reviewer authored the new audit integration/tests, then performed this separate comparison pass; no independence from that implementation is claimed.
